draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for being straight with me — take the week you need, and I won't crowd you while you're deciding.

One thing that often helps an evaluation: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so seeing how your team's real work sits in a project tends to answer the "is this the right fit" question faster than anything else. I saw you've got a first project going.

If it's useful, I'm happy to help you map one of your actual workflows into that project this week — just reply and I'll take it from there.

Best,
Chidi
